name: net.lazyedge/lazyedge
title: LazyEdge
description: NBA and NFL model probabilities and edges beside live market prices. One free game a day.

tools.name: free_game
tools.description: Today's free game, open to everyone without a key: the league, the matchup, the start time, our number on it now with the time it was produced and whether it is pregame or live, how far it has moved since the start, and which tools open the rest of it. Call this first without a key.

tools.name: nba_games
tools.description: Every NBA game today, before the tip and in play: the team our number has winning (`pick`) and our chance (`pick_p`), what our pregame picks at that chance have won this season, the market price on our pick, the edge, the score and the clock. Without an API key: today's free game only; any other game says what a plan unlocks.

tools.name: nba_props
tools.description: NBA player props for today's games: the line, our projection, our chance of the over, the market's and the edge in percentage points, live once a game starts. Largest edges first. Without an API key: today's free game only; any other game says what a plan unlocks.

game_id.description: One NBA game, by the game_id that nba_games returns (an ESPN event id). Today's games when left out.

stat.description: pts (points), reb (rebounds) or ast (assists). Every stat when left out.

limit.description: Rows to return, largest edge first.

tools.name: nba_spreads
tools.description: Every NBA spread line on Kalshi and Polymarket for a game or a team today: our chance the team covers, the price on each venue and the edge, largest first. The same line on both venues side by side shows where it is priced lower. Without an API key: today's free game only; any other game says what a plan unlocks.

game_id.description: One NBA game, by the game_id that nba_games returns (an ESPN event id). Today's games when left out.

team.description: Team code, such as NY, LAL or BOS.

limit.description: Rows to return, largest edge first.

tools.name: nba_totals
tools.description: Each NBA game's total today: the market's line and price beside our projected total, pregame and live. Without an API key: today's free game only; any other game says what a plan unlocks.

game_id.description: One NBA game, by the game_id that nba_games returns (an ESPN event id). Today's games when left out.

team.description: Team code, such as NY, LAL or BOS.

tools.name: nba_hit_rates
tools.description: How often an NBA player has gone over a line: his recent game log for a stat, his averages, and with a line how many of his last 5, last 10 and season games went over it.

stat.description: pts, reb, ast, 3pm (threes made), pra (points, rebounds and assists), stl or blk. Points, rebounds, assists, threes and pra when left out.

line.description: Count the games over this line.

games.description: How many of his most recent games to read (10 when left out).

tools.name: line_moves
tools.description: DraftKings' opening spread, total and moneyline beside its line now for each game still to start, with which way each moved relative to our number. Largest moves first. Without an API key: today's free game only; any other game says what a plan unlocks.

sport.description: nba or nfl (nba when left out).

tools.name: nfl_games
tools.description: This week's NFL games: our pick and chance, our projected score, the market's chance, our margin and total beside the spread and total lines, and the strongest edge on each game. Without an API key: today's free game only; any other game says what a plan unlocks.

tools.name: nfl_props
tools.description: NFL player props this week where a venue lists a line: our mean and median projection, our chance of the over at the line, the market's and the edge. Largest edges first, role questions left out. Without an API key: today's free game only; any other game says what a plan unlocks.

game_id.description: One NFL game, by the game_id that nfl_games returns, such as 2026_11_IND_HOU. Every game this week when left out.

stat.description: pass_yds (passing yards), rush_yds (rushing yards), rec_yds (receiving yards) or receptions. Every stat when left out.

limit.description: Rows to return, largest edge first.

tools.name: nfl_prop_pairs
tools.description: Same-game NFL prop pairs this week whose legs move together (a QB's passing yards with a teammate's receiving yards or catches, one receiver's catches with his yards): our chance both overs hit priced together with the correlation measured on every season since 2019, beside the two chances multiplied, and our chance and the market's on each leg. Strongest first; `favoured` marks a pair whose two overs we both favour at or above the market. With game_id and two legs it prices those two props instead, any two in the game, over or under, at any line. Without an API key: today's free game only; any other game says what a plan unlocks.

game_id.description: One NFL game, by the game_id that nfl_games returns, such as 2026_11_IND_HOU. Every game this week when left out.

favoured_only.description: Only pairs whose two overs we both favour.

legs.description: Two props in the game named by game_id, to price together. The line is the venue's main line when left out; p_over prices on your own chance, such as a live one.

line.description: The venue's main line when left out.

p_over.description: Your own chance of the over, to price on instead of ours.

limit.description: Rows to return, largest edge first.

tools.name: results
tools.description: How our numbers have graded: an NBA night or NFL week (the newest by default), each finished game with our pregame call on the winner, the spread and the total and whether it was right, and the season totals against the market. Free without a key.

sport.description: nba or nfl (nba when left out).

date.description: An NBA night, YYYY-MM-DD (newest when left out).

week.description: An NFL week this season (newest when left out).
